mapper.sql: SELECT 'PLAY' behavior_type, p.user_id actor_user_id, actor.nickname actor_name, p.video_id, v.title video_title, v.author_id target_user_id, author.nickname target_name, p.started_at occurred_at, NULL detail FROM play_records p JOIN users actor ON actor.id=p.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=p.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id UNION ALL SELECT le.event_type, le.user_id, actor.nickname, le.video_id, v.title, v.author_id, author.nickname, le.occurred_at, NULL FROM like_events le JOIN users actor ON actor.id=le.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=le.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id UNION ALL SELECT fe.event_type, fe.user_id, actor.nickname, fe.video_id, v.title, v.author_id, author.nickname, fe.occurred_at, NULL FROM favorite_events fe JOIN users actor ON actor.id=fe.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=fe.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id UNION ALL SELECT 'SHARE', s.user_id, actor.nickname, s.video_id, v.title, v.author_id, author.nickname, s.shared_at, NULL FROM share_records s JOIN users actor ON actor.id=s.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=s.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT', c.user_id, actor.nickname, c.video_id, v.title, v.author_id, author.nickname, c.created_at, c.content FROM comments c JOIN users actor ON actor.id=c.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=c.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT_DELETE', c.user_id, actor.nickname, c.video_id, v.title, v.author_id, author.nickname, c.deleted_at, c.content FROM comments c JOIN users actor ON actor.id=c.user_id JOIN videos v ON v.id=c.video_id JOIN users author ON author.id=v.author_id WHERE c.is_deleted=TRUE UNION ALL SELECT f.event_type, f.follower_id, actor.nickname, NULL, NULL, f.followed_id, target.nickname, f.occurred_at, NULL FROM follow_events f JOIN users actor ON actor.id=f.follower_id JOIN users target ON target.id=f.followed_id
